messages:
Dan: FYI the buyer at Meridian kicked back the security pack. Main asks: confirm DPA + SCCs, DSAR turnaround, proof we don't use customer data for training, deletion API example, and a 90-day export window on termination. POC starts Thurs. Can we answer in <48h? @Priya @Vik

Priya (Legal): We have a standard DPA + SCCs bundle we can share. It contains an explicit clause barring use of customer content for model training and a deletion API commitment. We can agree to a 30-day DSAR SLA for hosted. Export window: standard 90 days for hosted; we can redline for Dedicated.

Vik: Compliance bullets for SIG/CAIQ: AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.2+, SOC2 Type II available, MFA + RBAC, KMS for key management, annual pen-test, weekly vuln scans. Breach notif: 72 hours. I can prefill the security questionnaire.

Dan: Can we give a short curl sample for deletion the buyer can run during the POC? They want to test DSAR + deletion live.

Vik: Sure (admin only):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/data/delete \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"workspace_id":"meridian-poc","scope":"inference_logs"}'
```
Response returns job_id. Deletion follows SLA; backups may take up to 30 days unless contractually shortened.

Clara (Compliance): Note: for trials we can set request metadata retention to 7 days by config but backups still default 30 days. For vectors: default persistence is off for POCs; enable only if customer requests and signs consent. We provide a vector deletion endpoint too.

InfraBot: Provisioned workspace meridian-poc-501 (us-central-1). Lease rwd-9477. Assigned: Dan, Vik.

Priya (Legal): I'll upload DPA+SCCs and a redline with the training prohibition + 90-day export clause to the internal drive and share the link. Also will attach the sub-processor list and SOC2 report.

Dan: Perfect. Vik, can you pre-fill SIG/CAIQ and send to me by EOD? Priya, once docs are uploaded I'll send to buyer and confirm POC start.

Vik: On it, will handoff prefill in ~3 hours.

Dan: Thanks team — keep this tight, buyer expecting the DSAR/deletion demo during the POC.
